references.text: Describes how the fat is to be burned on the altar as a fire offering to the Lord, the same practice mentioned in Leviticus 7:31.
The previous verse describes that the breast is to be presented together with the fat as a wave offering before the Lord's face.
Explains that the waved breast and the raised thigh are given to Aaron and his sons as an everlasting right from the Israelites.
Moses takes the breast as his share during the consecration of the priests, showing the priests' right to the breast.
Confirms that the waved breast and the raised thigh belong to Aaron and his sons as their portion of the peace offering.
Describes the burning of the fat on the altar in connection with the consecration offering.
Moses receives the breast from the consecration ram as his share, parallel to the priests' right to the breast.
Confirms that the breast from the wave offering belongs to the priests together with the right thigh.
